content: better-auth session: expiresIn default 604800s (7d), updateAge default 86400s (1d, sliding-refresh window) -- satisfies AUTH-03 survive-refresh with zero extra code since better-auth already rolls expiresIn forward on use within updateAge. cookieCache (session.cookieCache.enabled + maxAge) is an optional short-TTL in-cookie cache to skip DB reads; cookies are httpOnly and secure-in-production by default. cookieOptions under advanced{} for custom name/domain/sameSite.
